# Suglow

> Suglow is an online cosmetics storefront serving customers in Bangladesh.

## Canonical website

- https://suglow.com/

## Main public sections

- Product catalogue: https://suglow.com/product
- Product details: https://suglow.com/product/{product-slug}

## Shopping and fulfilment

- Suglow sells 100% authentic/original products.
- Cash on delivery is available.
- Nationwide delivery is available across Bangladesh.
- Dhaka orders are dispatched the same day.
- Return and refund requests are handled under Suglow's published return/refund policy; customers should verify the current terms on the website or with Suglow before purchasing.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Use the canonical product page for current product names, descriptions, prices, and availability.
- Prices and stock can change; verify them on the current product page before answering.
- Do not invent additional delivery promises or return/refund terms beyond Suglow's published policy.

## Sitemap

- https://suglow.com/sitemap.xml
